dependent_on: ODSP PR#267 existing Serengeti photo-time results; external source contents UNOPENED as of contract registration.
biological_objective: Determine whether independent GPS fixes, 7 duck taxa/locations/years, support SAME INDIVIDUAL, SAME COARSE REGION and both seasonal branches of a shared approximate December-solstice daylength window. This is data admission ONLY; do not access/estimate movement-speed response on this first lane.

sampling.physical_id: study.name + individual.id distinct (IDs may collide across separate Movebank studies)
sampling.hemisphere: Northern lat>=+1 degree, Southern lat<=-1, near equator excluded from branch preflight due weak daylength signal
sampling.coarse_geography: 0.5 degree lat/lon cell computed privately; output never displays cell or original GPS coordinates
sampling.solstice_year: date of Dec 21 nearest season: Jul-Dec day => that year, Jan-Jun => prior year
sampling.branch_sign: north hemisphere: Dec21-k falling daylight, Dec21+k rising; southern hemisphere signs reversed
sampling.utc_date: Use UTC date for BROAD SOURCE preflight only, final biological solar test must resolve site-local solar calendar and geometry before outcomes
sampling.eligible_individual_cell_cycle: At least 7 distinct UTC dates AND 15 non-missing finite original GPS ground-speed observations in each of both increasing and decreasing photoperiod branches of the SAME 0.5-degree cell and December-solstice cycle.
sampling.support_more_than_one_hemisphere: Report support by species/hemisphere only, no GPS positions or individual IDs
sampling.enough_population_for_external_analysis: At least 10 distinct individuals meeting support spread over at least TWO independently sampled species and ≥2 coarse study geographic cells; otherwise HOLD independent cross-clade inference, not claim no response.

fields_and_q.note: Battery-driven sampling, collar-model 1h/2h fix schedules, missing GPS speed, animal flight migration strongly confound clock-time frequencies and observed displacement. Header/availability support cannot establish actual animal activity.

source_safety: Print only archive MD5, row total, schema column names, species-level counts and aggregate cell/datetime support. No source animal names/IDs, exact timestamps, latitude, longitude, or measured speed released. If source file MD5 fails, HOLD with no source information.
future_analysis_gate: Freeze actual matched measured daylength and source sampling effort after roster admission but BEFORE reading numerical ground.speed; no after-result tweaking taxon filters or solar-zone definitions.
original_source_prior_status: Published indexed 46.3 MB public dataset; source bytes unverified at registration.
